articles.title: Casio launches new range of metal watch accessories
articles.description: A new range of Casio G-Shock accessories has been released in China. These metal alloy pins are designed for customers to personalize their watch straps with various letters and a heart shape. Plus, the company has indicated that more of these pins could be released in the future.

articles.title: SteelSeries announces $599 Nova Elite gaming headset.
articles.description:
SteelSeries is launching its flagship Arctis Nova Elite gaming headset today, priced at an eye-watering $599.99. It’s the first gaming headset with wireless hi-res audio and SteelSeries is positioning it in a new category of luxury headsets that get closer to audiophile-grade performance. The Nova Elite can also connect to your phone, game console, and PC simultaneously.
[Link: SteelSeries Arctis Nova Elite review: $599 for premium, pricey, perfection | https://www.theverge.com/tech/788141/steelseries-arctis-nova-elite-review | The Verge]
